# mistershell_proxy (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell proxy by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_proxy" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_proxy" "by_name" {
  name = "proxy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `active_sessions` (Number) Active sessions.
- `connected_at` (String) Connected at.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Is enabled.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) Last heartbeat at.
- `location` (Dynamic) Location.
- `location_id` (Number) Location ID (required)
- `status` (String) Status.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Proxy authentication token. Shown only once at creation. Store it securely.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `version` (String) Version.
